triggers.desc: A value computed from the other fields with the filtrex `compute` rule, written into the data.

labelClass.desc: CSS classes of the label, which is rendered as markdown.

descriptionClass.desc: CSS classes of the description, rendered as markdown.

show.desc: Display the computed value under the label (the `noValue` i18n key when undefined).

data.desc: The result of the `compute` rule (`rules.compute` on the schema property or the control), re-evaluated whenever the form data changes; `undefined` while the control is hidden.
